_note: Paths are repo-relative so this file is portable; it previously hard-coded one contributor's home directory, which also meant the rules matched nothing after the directory was renamed. The eval runner reaches model APIs when --provider is not 'dry'. Keys come from ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY / BIOROUTER_LOCAL_URL in the environment and are never written to any file in this repository. --allow-code-exec executes model-generated code and belongs in a container. Never point --provider local at an endpoint holding regulated data, and never place regulated data in a task pack.
